article.title: Three Octobers in the West Bank, and the lands we can no longer reach
article.author: Qassam Muaddi
article.content: From my uncle's exasperated sighs over olive groves we can no longer reach, to the iron gates the Israeli army has erected at the edge of my village, there is one word we use to cope: 'aadi', or, "normal" in Arabic. But this reality is anything but.
source_folders: 06_左派ニュース・社会主義戦略
